Sunset Plains
tracks.description:
A calm New Age / ambient track with gentle guitar, soft pads, and drifting modal  
 melodies. Warm, peaceful, and horizon-like.  
   
 A Yoiyami-style atmospheric piece inspired by wide open landscapes and quiet morning wind.  
 Perfect for RPG overworlds, exploration fields, character introspection scenes, villages,  
 and emotional storytelling moments.
